view.matrix_convention: stored blocks are GPU column-major; math matrix = block.T; clip = math @ [x,y,z,1] (column vector)

view_uniform.contents_note: native uniform buffer content retained in the frame package; only the packed-view facts needed for projection are restated here

A.label: directly sunlit stone floor

scene_depth.units_note: SceneDepthZ is device Z; W = near_plane_cm / deviceZ.  This is view-forward depth in centimetres, not ray length.

vsm_shadow_mask.semantic: ShadowMaskTexture consumed as PS.LightAttenuationTexture by the sun pass; shader R is the 8-bit sqrt-encoded receiver attenuation, linear=(R/255)^2

A.world_route: SVPositionToTranslatedWorld at (x+0.5,y+0.5,deviceZ) divided by w, then minus PreViewTranslation

probe_index_convention: uniform probe index = atlas_y*80 + atlas_x for atlas_y < 45; adaptive probes are allocated after the 3600 uniform slots
world_units: centimetres for all native world/translation/depth values; metres are reported alongside

preexposure.note: all radiance/dispatch color values are native pre-exposed radiance unless a field says display or display_linear

receiver_selection.rule: task candidates A(500,680) B(720,680) C(626,587); validated with GBuffer material, device depth, world position, and covering 16x16 screen probe
receiver_selection.corrections: none of the candidates was moved; C's covering probe is 3 px above the receiver pixel and its normal differs by ~16 deg on the curved gold sphere, so an alternate nearby probe is recorded for context but the covering probe is not substituted

validity.note: shader parameter payload, not an RDG resource version; DumpGPU does not attach a DumpReadbackStatus record to this structure payload

shader_parameters.address_mapping: FScreenProbeParameters starts at byte 64 of the captured FParameters payload; field addresses are 64+metadata Offset

blue_noise_uniform.address_mapping: wrapped texture coordinate = ((screenTileX & maskX), (frame & maskZ)*dimY + (screenTileY & maskY))
